description: Use this when the user asks which websites or APIs they monitor, which are down, slow or paused, or what is in a group. Returns each site's status, last check, response time, 24-hour uptime, group, interval and SSL days left, filtered and paged. Not for one site's detail: use get_site.

group.description: Only sites in this group (exact name).

text.description: Only sites whose name or URL contains this.
